assimilation_state.question: How far has the theory increment actually travelled through the repository's structure?
active_complete_requires: EA-1 a SRT native proposition, guardrail or registered tension exists
EA-2 it has entered an appropriate active owner
EA-3 a real retrieval path resolves to it
EA-4 a fast layer or default load path can read it
EA-5 the superseded formulation has been handled
assimilation_state.note: active_complete is a claim about structure only. It never implies that any AI judgment actually changed.

behavior_validation.question: Has a fresh session been shown to judge differently because of the active content?
behavior_validation.note: Only a recorded, traceable run of the node's behavior suite may set this away from untested. The existence of a test file is not a result. CI cannot set this field.

derived_status_rule: effectively_assimilated := assimilation_state == 'active_complete' AND behavior_validation == 'passed'. It is computed, never stored. No file may hand-write a final label that contradicts the two axes.
